said: The Bank of Canada's real responses, recorded by meridian-bank-of-canada's authors on 2026-11-19, the body gzipped: Valet's CORRA with its percentiles and volume, the CORRA Compounded Index and the target for the overnight rate; its benchmark bond yields; and its daily exchange rates, each from 3 August to 19 November 2026, as JSON; and the zero-coupon yield curves from 3 August 2026 to the latest published, 28 October 2026, as CSV. The Bank allows its website's content to be used, copied and distributed with credit to the Bank and a note of any changes, implying no endorsement (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/). Sample data answers each request for a range from them, and the tests read them.
